newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close easier, no real interest.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close easier, no real interest.

text.p: UK grain futures closed easier but lacked any real interest due to many players extending their Christmas holidays, traders said.
"Its really only skeleton staffing at most firms just in case there's a tender somewhere," one trader said.
Wheat futures ended 0.40 to 0.75 sterling down, while barley finished 0.50 to 0.75 sterling lower. Volume totalled 35 lots and 41 lots respectively.
No trade was reported on the delivered market.
